name: megle
description: Windows-first local media browser indexing existing folders.

scripts.check:core-client: npm --workspace @megle/core-client run check && npm --workspace @megle/core-client run typecheck && npm --workspace @megle/core-client run test
scripts.check:notification-contract: npm --workspace @megle/notification-contract run check && npm --workspace @megle/notification-contract run typecheck && npm --workspace @megle/notification-contract run test
scripts.check:desktop: node tools/checks/validate-desktop-core.mjs && npm --workspace @megle/desktop run typecheck && npm --workspace @megle/desktop run test
scripts.build:desktop-package: node tools/build/build-bundled-plugins.mjs --release-profile && cargo build --release -p megle-core && npm --workspace @megle/web run build && npm --workspace @megle/desktop run build && node tools/build/generate-desktop-icon.mjs && node tools/build/package-desktop.mjs
scripts.check:web: node tools/checks/validate-web-client.mjs && npm --workspace @megle/web run typecheck && npm --workspace @megle/web run test
scripts.test: npm run check:structure && npm run check:core-api && npm run check:core-client && npm run check:notification-contract && npm run check:desktop && npm run check:web && npm run check:ui-design && npm run check:schema && npm run check:rust
